equivalence_rules: Rank0 is a scalar branch, rank1 vector, rank2 matrix, rank3 first higher-rank branch, rank4 exercises multiple fixed-slice/carry axes; rank32 probes configured metadata boundary. Higher ranks remain the same checked loops, not a claim that every size was executed.
Scalar encoders require all12wirecodes. Shared rank traversal may be grouped only with byte-width, complex-component, alias/alignment and overflow interactions independently covered.

MM compatibility classes come from the exact frozen table. Pattern array and noncomplex Hermitian are invalid-format negative cases; CSR/CSC require rank2. Promised supported modes may not be reclassified as invalid.

Cleanup order after a codec result is structurally independent of shape/scalar, but still requires validation of both header-defined helper implementations, all storage kinds, and actual platform/linkage File behavior. Existing scoped Linux evidence alone does not establish the grouping.
